  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION

  Data Analytics with Python [NPT-3201]  
  Marks: 50                                                                           Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           In a company, 60% of employees are male and 40% are female. 70% of the males and  
  50% of the females prefer work-from-home. Apply the concept of conditional  
  probability to find the probability that a randomly chosen employee prefers work-from- (5)  
  A)      home?  
  
  B)      A sample of 11 circuits from your large normal population has a mean resistance of 2.20  
  ohms. We know from past testing that the population standard deviation is 0.35 ohms.    (5)  
  Identify 95% confidence interval for the true mean resistance of the population.  
  
  2)           Explain the concept of Two-Way ANOVA and how it differs from One-Way ANOVA.  
  Include the types of factors involved and a practical example where Two-Way ANOVA  
  (5)  
  is applicable  
  A)  
  B)      Build a two-sample t-test to compare the average salaries of employees in two  
  departments of a company. Use a significance level of 0.05 and explain how you          (5)  
  interpret the results.  
  
  3)           Prepare an analysis report on the concept of linear regression and its application in  
  modelling the relationship between a dependent and independent variable. Also, list the  
  (5)  
  assumptions made in linear regression analysis.  
  A)  
  B)      Apply the concept of Maximum Likelihood Estimation to estimate the parameter of a  
  normal distribution given a small sample of data.                                       (5)  
  
  4)           Analyse the role of the ROC curve in evaluating the performance of a binary  
  classification model. What does the area under the ROC curve (AUC) indicate about the  
  (5)  
  model's accuracy?  
  A)  
  B)                                                                                              (5)
